time/rfc3339#

Strict nanosecond-resolution RFC 3339 timestamps.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Rfc3339(
    origin: clock.instant(),
    offset: Duration(seconds: 0.rat()),
).string(); // ...Z

let instant = Rfc3339("2026-08-11T12:30:45.125+05:00").instant();

Description#

Strict nanosecond-resolution RFC 3339 timestamps.

This profile requires uppercase T/Z, seconds and either Z or ±HH:MM. Fractions contain one through nine digits and are never rounded. Numeric offsets must be whole minutes and have magnitude below 24 hours. Parsing accepts RFC 3339 -00:00 as a zero displacement with unknown local-offset provenance; formatting canonicalizes every zero displacement to Z.
